text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding sample app failing for a customer demo. Repro steps in a sec.
aj: ugh, what error?
maria: The JS SDK in JSON mode is returning a tool call payload that the sample app's schema validator rejects. Works fine locally for me sometimes, flaky.
kai: Could be the retry wrapper. We saw double-stringifying before.
maria: Stack snippet from the runtime log: 
```
2026-03-18T19:12:03Z ERROR handler: failed to validate tool output: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
Received payload: "{\"action\": \"open_file\", \"path\": \"/tmp/config.json\",}"
```
ellie: trailing comma + wrapped-in-quotes — aha. So the payload is both malformed JSON and double-encoded (string containing JSON).
aj: That trailing comma looks like the model generated it. But why would it be wrapped in quotes? retry wrapper maybe doing `JSON.stringify(response)` before sending to the SDK helper?
maria: Sequence: sample app calls SDK -> SDK auth fails (401) -> auth retry triggers -> on retry we re-run the low-level tool caller which accepts args as object, but our retry shim passes the serialized body (string) instead of the parsed object. So validator sees a string, not an object.
kai: I remembered we had a similar parity test fail between py & js: JS retry helper returns `body: JSON.stringify(toolOutput)` while Python kept the object. Tests didn't catch because we mock network layer differently.
ellie: Repro command for devs: 
```
# run sample app locally with debug
ENV=dev DEBUG=devex:tooling node sample-app/index.js
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/run -d @prompt.json -H 'Authorization: Bearer bad-token'
```
maria: Minimal fix idea: change retry wrapper to preserve original `toolResponse` shape and only re-attach auth headers, not re-serialize. Also add a small unit test: retry when auth fails should pass the exact previously-constructed `toolArgs` to the retried call.
aj: Sounds right. I can patch the JS SDK today. @kai can you add a parity test that calls the SDK in JSON mode and asserts the lambda receives a JSON object (not a string) for toolcall args?
kai: Yep. I'll add a JS + Py integration test that runs with a fake 401 gateway and ensures the eventual tool invocation payload is identical across retries.
maria: Also can we add a validator in sample-app boot sequence that logs the raw incoming body if schema validation fails? That should make debugging less painful for customers.
ellie: Good DX improvement. I'll add a tiny middleware and a user-facing note in the sample app README.
aj: One more gotcha — streaming vs non-streaming in JSON mode. If the SDK switches to streaming on retries, some middleware expecting full body will mis-handle and re-stringify chunks. Add an assertion that retry preserves transport mode.
maria: Oof. Add to the PR checklist.
devrel-bot: New issue created: DEVEX-4723 "sample-app: toolcall double-encode on auth retry (JSON mode)" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEVEX-4723 :eyes:
aj: PR incoming: will include fix + unit+integration tests + changelog entry. ETA EOD.
kai: I'll run a few fuzz prompts to see if the trailing-comma model output keeps happening — might want to add a small sanitizer that strips trailing commas before parsing.
ellie: If we add sanitizer, flag as heuristic and behind a feature flag. We should prefer preserving model output unless it's clearly malformed.
maria: Agreed. For the demo, we'll patch SDK to keep shapes correct and add a one-off sanitizer until model/regression fix is in place.
aj: thx — ping me when PR is up, i'll review fast. :thumbsup:
